digest.component_or_area: Backend adapter port and RemoteRef construction
propositions: RemoteRef.instance field is never populated in production code; it must be constructed from normalized base URL and injected at backend construction time
Backend port lacks a declared remote_ref() member that production backends implement; FakeBackend implemented it unilaterally since J7, creating an asymmetry in the contract
RemoteRef.instance does not prevent local-ticket-id collisions between same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives ids from Jira keys alone, independent of instance value
instance value must be resolved at backend construction in build_backend factories rather than at remote_ref() call time to avoid ambient config resolution that breaks contract tests
vendor field already separates Cloud from DataCenter deployments; instance disambiguates only between multiple deployments of the same vendor
